Actual nuspec license metadata (preserved verbatim): this package's .nuspec contains no
<license> SPDX expression element, and its only license reference is the legacy field
<licenseUrl>https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xunit/xunit/master/license.txt</licenseUrl>,
which points at the shared xUnit.net project license file. That raw-GitHub URL is a moving
pointer and is not fetched offline. The .nupkg embeds no license file.

targets the xUnit.net project license. Every sibling xUnit package vendored here — xunit

xunit.extensibility.execution 2.8.1, xunit.analyzers 1.14.0, and

in its own .nuspec, so the applicable license for this same-project package is Apache-2.0,

from sibling package metadata, not from an SPDX element in this package's own nuspec.
